login.headline:
Bring your organization
into focus.
login.description: One place for your people, organizational structure and access. Built around the way your team works.
login.subtitle: Sign in to your administration workspace.
login.help: Contact your administrator to open an account or reset your password.
login.secure: Protected by an encrypted password and secure session.
login.footer: A clear structure. The right access.

overview.title: Data statistics
overview.subtitle: A clear view of your people, structure and access.
overview.chartSubtitle: Cumulative accounts created in the last 7 days
overview.scopeNote: Only records within your authorized scope are shown.
overview.accessHint: Connect role permissions and account overrides.
overview.securityTitle:
The right access,
at every level.
overview.securityHint: Role permissions + account overrides, with department-level data scopes.
overview.recentEmpty: Your workspace is ready. Add your first team account.

accounts.title: Account management
accounts.subtitle: Manage your people, their roles and individual access.
accounts.description: An account can join multiple departments, each with its own roles and permissions.
accounts.passwordHint: 12–128 characters. Leave blank to keep the existing password when editing.
accounts.adminHint: The built-in administrator has full workspace access and cannot be disabled or deleted.
accounts.roleHint: Permissions from active roles in the selected department are combined.
accounts.overrideHint: Inherit uses role permissions. An individual allow replaces the inherited data scope; an explicit deny blocks the operation.

organizations.title: Organization management
organizations.subtitle: Build a clear hierarchy of enterprises and companies.
organizations.description: An enterprise contains companies; accounts belong to a company.
organizations.kindHint: The organization type cannot be changed after creation.

departments.title: Department management
departments.subtitle: Organize your teams and establish department data boundaries.
departments.description: Department hierarchies remain within the same company.

roles.title: Role management
roles.subtitle: Create reusable roles and define what each role can access.
roles.description: Role permissions are inherited by all assigned accounts.

permissions.title: Permission management
permissions.subtitle: Configure role access and individual account overrides in one place.
permissions.scopeHint: Data access always remains inside the current workspace.
permissions.grantAdminHint: Allows managing all role policies and account grants in this workspace. Assign carefully.
permissions.legend: Account overrides take priority; otherwise role permissions are inherited.
permissions.noSelection: Select a role or account to configure access.
permissions.readOnly: You can view this configuration. Access changes require the manage-access permission.

feedback.emptyHint: Create a record or adjust your filters to get started.
feedback.deleteDescription: “{{name}}” will be permanently removed. Records with members or child records must be cleared first.

errors.invalid: Check the entered values and related records.
errors.unauthenticated: The account or password is incorrect, the account is disabled, or too many attempts were made.
errors.expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission, or the target is outside your data scope.
errors.not_found: The record is unavailable or outside your data scope.
errors.conflict: The code or account may already exist, the record is in use, or a protected account would be affected.
errors.unavailable: The service is not ready. Check the API and database connection.
errors.internal: The operation could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many sign-in attempts. Please try again later.

validation.code: Use 2–40 letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens.
validation.username: Use 3–80 letters, numbers, dots, @, underscores or hyphens.
validation.note: Use no more than 500 characters in review notes.

profile.title: Your account
profile.session: Signed in with an 8-hour secure session.

guide.title: How access works
guide.one: Role permissions are combined across all active roles.
guide.two: An account can receive independent allows or explicit denies. A deny takes precedence.
guide.three: Data scope can be limited to a company, department, department tree, own account or selected departments.
guide.four: The server verifies every request and applies tenant and data-scope conditions in SQL.

temporary.title: Temporary access
temporary.subtitle: Request permissions or a broader data scope for a limited time.
temporary.approvalHint: Review other accounts’ requests within your permanent authority. Self-approval is prohibited.
temporary.scopeHint: You can request a missing permission or expand an existing data scope. The approver may change permissions, duration and scope.
temporary.policyHint: Explicit denies remain effective. Approval and policy administration cannot be granted temporarily. Approved relative ranges are fixed at approval. Security-sensitive identity, credential, policy and membership changes still require permanent authority.
temporary.durationHint: Validity starts at approval and ends automatically on the server.
temporary.grantRequired: Select at least one permission and choose departments for a custom scope.
temporary.revokeHint: The active temporary grant will stop authorizing the next request.

memberships.title: Department access
memberships.hint: Each department has its own roles and permission overrides. Switch departments to use that context.
memberships.adminHint: Full administrator access is protected in the primary department. Add or select an additional department to configure its roles and permissions independently.
memberships.restricted: Department access requires permission administration. Only the built-in administrator can edit their own department memberships.
